_how: One entry per language. 'default' is the language the picture is cut to; every other language is fitted into its line slots. To add a language: add an entry here and write studio/cartoon/episodes/lang/<episode>.<code>.json (see docs/multilang/ADD_A_LANGUAGE.md).

es-419.name: Spanish (Latin America)
es-419.note: pitch: ef_dora speaks at a median of 168 Hz, Milo's English voice at 195 Hz (measured Nov 16); +2.6 semitones puts Milo at the same height in every language
es-419.note_m: a character whose English voice is a male voice (Tumble: am_puck) takes em_alex; em_alex speaks at a median of 127 Hz, am_puck at 117 Hz (measured Nov 20): -1.5 semitones, then the character's own offset is added

pt-BR.name: Portuguese (Brazil)
pt-BR.note_m: pm_alex median 129 Hz against am_puck 117 Hz (measured Nov 20)

fit.note: a line may use its English line's time plus the pause after it, minus min_end_gap_s; the voice is never faster than speed 1.0 (the model's normal pace; the English is spoken at 0.8)

_cast: Stories have a cast: every character keeps its English offsets from Milo (pitch, formant, speed) on the language's voice; a male English voice takes 'voice_m'. A line that is '=' in the adaptation keeps the English recording (the channel's name in the main intro).
